metaDescription: Order custom with zipper lip balm for giveaways. Perfect for trade shows, events, and corporate gifts. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Zip-up lip balm holders keep your logo close at hand while preventing balm from getting lost in pockets or bags. These practical carriers are ideal for outdoor events, travel promos, and safety kits where easy access matters. Choose from a variety of balm formulas and zipper pouch colors to match your brand. Custom imprinting on the pouch or the balm tube itself ensures your message stays visible. Whether you're outfitting a sales team or gifting attendees, a zippered lip balm offers convenience and repeated brand exposure.
